current.source_preparation_copy: Commercial food-grade material is commonly isolated and purified from vegetable-oil fractions rich in tocopherols.
current.tile_summary: Delta-tocopherol is one of the naturally occurring tocopherols in the vitamin E family.
current.expanded_summary: Delta-tocopherol is one of the naturally occurring tocopherols in the vitamin E family. It is fat-soluble and can help slow oxidation.
current.fact_1_copy: Found naturally in vegetable oils and other plant foods.
current.fact_2_copy: Used as an antioxidant in fat-containing foods.

proposed.source_preparation_copy: Manufactured by chemical synthesis as a defined delta-tocopherol preparation and purified to food-additive specifications.
proposed.tile_summary: Synthetic delta-tocopherol is a manufactured form of one of the tocopherols in the vitamin E family.
proposed.expanded_summary: Synthetic delta-tocopherol is a manufactured form of one of the tocopherols in the vitamin E family. In the Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code it is listed as synthetic delta-tocopherol (309), distinct from mixed tocopherols concentrate (307b). It is fat-soluble and is used as an antioxidant in fat-containing foods.
proposed.fact_1_copy: FSANZ Schedule 15 lists 309 as synthetic delta-tocopherol, separate from mixed tocopherols concentrate (307b).
proposed.fact_2_copy: Used as an antioxidant in fat-containing foods.
proposed.fact_3_copy: The additive number alone does not mean the ingredient was extracted as a mixed natural tocopherol concentrate.

e309.distinction: Naturally occurring delta-tocopherol in oils ≠ Schedule 15 commercial additive identity 309 (synthetic delta-tocopherol). Mixed natural homologues belong under 307b.
